story: Early breakaway of six riders, with Tom Maingenaud extending his lead in the mountains classification. Caught 65 km from the finish. Numerous attacks in the finale, but none succeed. Benoît Cosnefroy wins the sprint among 13 riders, securing the stage victory and overall lead.
